**Finding: Compliant** (no redline proposed)

The agreement imposes no minimum purchase commitment on Sparkling:

- **§ 11 (Fees)** — payment is limited to "the fees as set out in the Fee Schedule," with no committed volume or spend.
- **§ 2 (Grant of License)** — additional fees arise only if Sparkling elects to use the Software beyond the Authorized Locations, i.e., ordered items only.
- **§ 10 (Maintenance)** — a "renewable one-year term," not a multi-year committed maintenance stream.
- **§ 17(a)–(b)** — the license runs perpetually "as long as fees are paid," and Sparkling may terminate at any time on 90 days' notice, giving a clean exit.
- **§ 3** — restrictions are conventional IP/scope-of-use limits (copying, reverse engineering, assignment), not volume caps on our usage.

This satisfies the preferred position, so no edit is warranted. One diligence point flagged in the finding: Schedule "A" (Fee Schedule) is referenced but not included in the reviewed text, and should be checked for minimum quantities, seat/location floors, or non-refundable multi-year prepayments before signature.
